name: Hot Honey Latte
caffeineNote: Not stated on the label; the brand publishes 125 mg
summary: Cold brew latte sweetened with organic honey and spiked with chili extract — the only deliberately spicy can we track — at 11 g of sugar (just 4 g of it added) and 5 g of protein per 8 oz can, 90 calories, with 125 mg of caffeine.
